# BEFORE REPORTING:
If reporting a security vulnerability, please go [here](https://github.com/etangaming123/rafisol/security).

Check if the bot is online. This can be done with /ping. If the /ping command does not work, the bot is offline, and this bug should not be reported. 
If the command does work, you may report this bug.

# Describe the bug
A clear and concise description of what the bug is.
## Example
✅Good:
rafisol does not save setting x when using the web editor, even though it is present in the exported .json file.
❌Bad:
rafisol is broken

## Write the bug description below.

# To Reproduce
Steps to reproduce the behavior.

## Example
✅Good:
1. Use command /export to export data
2. Open the exported .json in the web editor
3. Setting x is missing from the editor, but is present in the .json file
4. Setting x is not saved when you import the file back into rafisol, even when manually editing .json
❌Bad:
1. Export
2. Broken

## Write the steps below.

# Expected behavior
A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.

## Example
✅Good: rafisol should have done x when y happened, but instead it did z.
❌Bad: it did not give me answer

## Write the expected behavior below.

# Screenshots
If applicable, add screenshots to help explain your problem.

# Additional context
Add any other context about the problem here.
